randomness: none; repetitions are fresh identical learner processes, not independent random seeds
reset: fixed initial C=(C0,C1); WorldSpec.reset(C,0,0) per object before every MQ
inputs: explicit ordered Step/Clamp alphabet in each named profile; no text and no hidden IDs
outputs: all after-step R0,M0,C0,Y0,R1,M1,C1,Y1 bits encoded injectively as one integer, MSB first
membership: execute complete prefix+suffix from reset, return suffix outputs only; no cache
equivalence: complete BFS of reachable reference x exported hypothesis product; shortest CE in frozen alphabet order
exact_eq_privilege: evaluator enumerates all simulator states reachable from reset and compares transition outputs; only distinguishing input/output words returned to learner
minimum: independent Python partition refinement of full reference Mealy table
symbols_executed: physical Step executions in membership queries, including prefix replay; excludes privileged reference BFS/EQ table comparisons
eq_count: all conjectures including final successful exact EQ; CE output obtained from reference, not counted as MQ
pass: all 60 trials complete; every exported hypothesis has no exact counterexample and size equals independently minimized reference
scope: finite deterministic fixed-alphabet predictive baseline only; does not establish causal semantics, stochastic learning, language training, scaling, or overall G0
